LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Title: Outpost system guide
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Subtitle: Read this before you start
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.ConfirmLocked: Please read the guide above first.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Important.Build: Select a caravan on the map to found an outpost. Make sure the caravan has arrived at an empty spot.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Important.Units: Anyone inside an outpost skips all calculations entirely, with no performance cost at all.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Important.Multi: The production multiplier can be changed in the mod settings.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Important.UiSty: The interface uses the RimWorld style by default. A modern tech style can be selected in the mod settings.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Important.Manag: Click an outpost, then click the manage button below.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Important.Disab: Turn this popup off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Knowledge.Defen: A colonist's melee or shooting ability raises defense. Defense facilities can also be built to raise it.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Knowledge.Speci: Some special buildings require selecting an outpost on the map and then clicking a button.
Raids occur from time to time against a randomly chosen outpost. The result is decided by a defense roll.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.IntroTips.Knowledge.Bomba: After building a mortar, select an outpost on the map and click the bombardment button.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.Settings.ShowIntroTips.De: Shows the outpost system guide every time you start a new game or load a save.
